summary: A primitive stone pickaxe for a survival game: a 0.67 m hardwood haft (a real pick haft runs 60-90 cm) with a… options haft_wood; sockets edge, grip_r, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.stone_pickaxe or place "prefab": "stone_pickaxe" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
